chunks: And Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya and Ibn Abi Umayr from Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'Complete the Hajj and Umrah for Allah' [2:196], concerning a man who performs Tamattu' (Umrah then Hajj) instead of that individual Umrah (Umrat al-Mufradah), he said: Thus did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) command his companions.
ai.seo_question: What is the legal status of Umrat al-Tamattu' according to the Quranic verse 'Complete the Hajj and Umrah for Allah'?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Quranic command to 'complete' Hajj and Umrah (2:196) is fulfilled through Umrat al-Tamattu', thereby exempting the pilgrim from performing a separate, distinct Umrah. This ruling aligns with the practice of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), establishing the legal precedence for combining the two rites during the Hajj season. The narration underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that the Tamattu' Umrah serves as the primary obligatory Umrah for those performing Hajj al-Tamattu'.
